data_quality: official-static-research-sources; no live market or user-account data
tooling_degradation: astock.capabilities was not called because the local Python environment lacks declared runtime dependencies (including typer). Source records are stored in this auditable fallback registry.

sources.title: Blackstone Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
sources.claim_use: strategy breadth, perpetual-capital structure and infrastructure/real-asset orientation
sources.limitation: Describes the manager's business and process; it does not independently establish return attribution or retail replicability.

sources.title: KKR & Co. Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
sources.claim_use: private-equity, real-assets, credit/liquid-strategy and insurance-platform structure
sources.limitation: Manager filing, not a proof that an outside investor can obtain its sourcing, governance or operating leverage.

sources.title: Apollo Global Management, Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
sources.claim_use: direct origination, asset-backed/multi-credit and retirement-services business context
sources.limitation: The document supports a credit-first underwriting analogy, not direct retail participation in private origination or Athene liability matching.

sources.title: Brookfield Corporation 2025 Annual Information Form
sources.claim_use: owner-operator model, operating businesses and infrastructure/real-asset exposure
sources.limitation: Owner-operator capabilities, private negotiations and long-duration financing are institution-specific.

sources.title: The Carlyle Group Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
sources.claim_use: global private equity, credit, AlpInvest primary/secondary/co-investment and portfolio-finance platform description
sources.limitation: Does not turn private-fund secondary/co-investment access into a retail-public-market strategy.

sources.title: Bain Capital Private Equity (Europe) Walker Annual Report 2025
sources.limitation: Self-description; any claimed value-creation attribution remains manager-reported and not independently audited here.

sources.title: TPG Inc. 2025 Form 10-K
sources.claim_use: six-platform organisation spanning capital, growth, impact, credit, real estate and market solutions
sources.limitation: A platform taxonomy is not evidence for a tradeable thematic signal.

sources.title: Measures for the Administration of Margin Financing and Securities Lending Business of Securities Companies
sources.limitation: Not used as the current operative-rule source; current exchange rules, account contracts and broker conditions must be verified separately.

sources.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange Trading Rules (2026 revision, operative attachment and deferred-provisions attachment)
sources.limitation: Deferred-provisions attachment was separately checked; instrument exceptions, product documents and account permissions must still be verified before any trade.

sources.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange Measures for Publicly Offered Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) (Trial)
sources.claim_use: publicly offered real-estate REIT business boundary and its links to the applicable infrastructure-REIT guidance and commercial-real-estate REIT pilot context
sources.limitation: The operative measures support a due-diligence framework only; product classification, current prospectus, operating and valuation evidence must be checked for each project.

sources.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange Guidelines No. 1 for Publicly Offered Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) — Issuance and Listing Administration (June 2026 revision)
sources.claim_use: issuance, listing and suitability context for publicly offered real-estate REITs
sources.limitation: This operational issuance/listing guide is not a valuation source and does not replace product-specific diligence or the applicable underlying-asset rules.

sources.title: Shenzhen Stock Exchange Trading Rules (2026 current PDF)
sources.claim_use: Shenzhen settlement, price-limit and instrument-rule context
sources.limitation: Specific instrument and account exceptions must be verified before implementation.

sources.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange ETF Business Rules
sources.claim_use: ETF category-specific creation/redemption mechanics and the need to distinguish them from secondary-market disposal
sources.limitation: The locally reviewed attachment addresses specified categories; ETF trading, subscription/redemption and reverse-trading mechanics are product- and rule-specific.

sources.title: Shanghai Stock Exchange Margin Financing and Securities Lending Detailed Rules (2023 revision, operative attachment)
sources.claim_use: exchange-side margin and securities-lending implementation context
sources.limitation: Does not constitute an account eligibility or suitability determination; the release page states that Article 12(3) continues not to be implemented pending separate SSE notice, and broker contracts or current exchange notices can impose additional conditions.
